intro: Ask Clafina for help, see what has been answered, and choose what is sent with your question. Support can look inside your account only when an owner agrees, for the time the owner chooses.
start: Start typing your question on Ask for help. The guide suggests answers as you type, and one may already answer it.
Send your question if it does not. The answer comes back here, and by email.

articles.after: Your case is listed under your cases, newest first. Waiting for you means Clafina has replied and waits for your answer: open the case, write back and press Send.
tips: Waiting to be sent means Clafina could not be reached. What you wrote is kept and sent as soon as it can be.
Once a case is resolved, you are asked how the help was.

articles.title: Let Clafina support look inside your account
articles.summary: Support asks with a reason. An owner chooses how long, and every page they looked at is listed after.
before: Only an owner can answer a request for access.
